A''' mining camp''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dellalt/Legends|Dellalt]] from which [[J'uoch]] operated a small [[:Category:Criminals|criminal]] organization. The camp was overrun by the reactivated [[Guardian Corps]] from [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] the Despot.
